//: PLACEHOLDER CONTENT. Every string below describes what belongs in it. Replace the values, keep the keys.
title: Project title
subtitle: Subtitle — one line placing the project, e.g. the building and what changed
summary: Summary — one or two sentences. Shown on the work index and used as the social share description, so it has to read well on its own.

cover.//: Replace src with a real photograph under media/. Paths are relative to wwwroot and must NOT start with a slash. width/height are the file's real pixel dimensions — they reserve the space so the page never jumps while loading. placeholder is a colour sampled from the photo, painted in that reserved space. Add a srcSet once you have multiple sizes: 'media/x-800.jpg 800w, media/x-1600.jpg 1600w'.
cover.alt: Alt text — describe what the photograph actually shows.

blocks.//: PROSE — headed body copy. The workhorse block.
blocks.heading: Section heading
paragraphs: Paragraph. One entry per paragraph; plain text only, no markup.

blocks.//: IMAGE — width is Inset | Wide | Full. parallax is the drift depth; 0 disables it and 0.1 is a sensible ceiling.
GALLERY — layout is Mosaic | Pair | Triptych | Filmstrip. Clicking any image opens the lightbox.
COMPARISON — draggable before/after slider. Both images must share an aspect ratio.

before.alt: Alt text describing the room before the work.

after.alt: Alt text describing the same view after the work.

blocks.//: SCENE — an interactive 3D model. Nothing 3D is downloaded until the visitor presses 'View in 3D'. models/example.glb does not exist yet, so pressing it shows the viewer's fallback message; drop a .glb into wwwroot/models/ and point modelUrl at it. Delete this block if you do not want a 3D view here.
blocks.heading: Scene heading
blocks.description: Description — one line about the object.

scene.alt: Alt text — the only description a screen reader gets, since a canvas has no readable content.

poster.alt: Alt text for the still shown before the model loads.

metadata.//: Optional. Overrides the page description and social image for this project only.

//: A shorter project. Only slug, title, summary, category and cover are required; every other field can be omitted.
title: Project title
subtitle: Subtitle

//: Category is free text. Adding a new one here makes a new filter appear on /work automatically — no code change.
title: Project title
subtitle: Subtitle
